messages:
Maria Chen: :loudspeaker: Heads-up — Control plane planned maintenance scheduled Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. We are doing a small DNS rotation and proxy restart across a subset of API gateways. Expected rolling restarts with a single-digit minute impact per region, overall window ~10-15m. Low risk but please monitor. Draft status page + customer notify below; ask for quick review.

incident-bot: Created maintenance record MAINT-2063034500. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maint-control-plane-rotation. Paging policy: oncall -> escalation -> eng-ops.

Samir Patel: Thanks Maria. Quick q: will Dedicated Dedicated pools be impacted (routing, bursts)?

Maria Chen: Good q — Dedicated compute will not have GPU disruptions; only control plane proxies may see transient 1-2s request errors during individual proxy swaps. Dedicated routing falls back to cached routing info so no sustained throughput loss. I'll add a note for Enterprise customers.

Jessica Lin: Draft status page blurb (2 variants):
- Short: "Planned maintenance: Control plane DNS/proxy rotation — some API requests may briefly return 5xx/502. Expected short window."
- Expanded: "We are performing a planned control plane rotation to refresh outbound DNS entries across gateways. You may experience brief request failures (few seconds) in affected regions. Clients will automatically retry; no model or data changes. Window: 02:00-03:00 UTC."

Evan Brooks: Can we have an explicit customer email template? Some customers asked for proactive notice. I can send from Support if we agree on wording.

Jessica Lin: Customer email draft (support-friendly):
```
Hi <customer>,

On Tue Mar 24 at 02:00-03:00 UTC we will perform a planned control plane maintenance that may cause brief request failures (typically seconds) for a small subset of requests. Your Dedicated compute will not be affected. No action required on your side; retries should succeed automatically. If you see persistent errors beyond 10 minutes, please reply to this thread or open a ticket.

Apologies for any inconvenience — we aim for a seamless rotation.
Best, Redwood Support
```

Maria Chen: Additions: include hotline link, and for customers on Reserved/Dedicated add the contact alias `#dedicated-ops`. Also mark the statuspage components: Control Plane (service: control-plane-api), Status: maintenance-scheduled -> in-progress -> completed.

Samir Patel: On-call plan: Maria primary (pager on), Samir backup (30m shadow), Evan support standby. Escalation: if request error-rate > 1% (rolling 5m) or latency spike > 500ms p95, escalate immediately.

Jessica Lin: How should we detect the error-rate? Use metrics query: `rb-query "sum(rate(http_request_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests[5m])) > 0.01"` set an alert job to ping pager.

Evan Brooks: I'll pre-populate a support ticket template and schedule the outbound email for 6h before the window. Also posting a note in the customer portal.

Maria Chen: Ops checklist before window:
- Push statuspage scheduled incident (tag components) : Sarah to approve copy.
- Pre-warm failover caches.
- Increase sampling for traces in the 30m pre/post window.
- Have `rb-query` + `kubectl logs` snippet ready for quick checks.

Samir Patel: Can we add a quick runbook snippet for oncall?

Maria Chen: Runbook snippet (paste in thread):
```
1) Check MAINT-2063034500 runbook link.
2) Query metrics: `rb-query "http_request_errors / http_requests"` (5m).
3) If error-rate > 1% for 5m -> `pager oncall` (tag: control-plane).
4) If region-wide 502 spikes, fail traffic to standby region: `rb-route shift --to=eu-west1-standby` (manual approval required).
5) After completion, close statuspage incident and post completion note.
```

incident-bot: Reminder: maintenance scheduled at 2063034500 -> 2063038100 (system window record). Notifications queued for 6h and 30m prior.

Jessica Lin: Tiny tweak to customer email — add a small bullet about SDK retries with default backoff. That should reduce support noise.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Final customer line: "If you use our SDKs, built-in retry/backoff will handle transient errors; no action needed."

Samir Patel: Pre-run checks all green. I will stay in the #oncall room during the window. Maria, please ping if you need escalation.

Maria Chen: Starting maintenance now (02:00 UTC). Will post updates if anything unexpected. :eyes:

incident-bot: MAINT-2063034500 status changed to in-progress. Notifying subscribed stakeholders.

Maria Chen: Observed one short region-level 502 spike at 02:07 UTC — lasted ~12s, retries succeeded. No customer-facing tickets so far. Monitoring closely.

Evan Brooks: Confirmed support queue quiet; no spikes in inbound tickets.

Samir Patel: Metrics look good — p95 latency unchanged. No escalation required.

Maria Chen: Maintenance complete. Total observed window ~12m; brief 502s during rotation, auto-retries covered. Updating status page to "Completed". :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: MAINT-2063034500 marked completed by Maria Chen at 02:12 UTC. Closure note: "Control plane rotation complete. Brief transient 502 observed; no sustained impact. Please reach out if you see issues."

Jessica Lin: I'll send the post-maintenance customer follow-up and close the support ticket template.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone for quick reviews and coverage. Filing a short retro in #eng-postmortems with notes and one suggested improvement: add automated lightweight pre-warm for proxies to reduce the 502 blip. :thumbsup:
